mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad-based consumer demand contraction, triggering negative earnings outlooks and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline by at least 0.5% from prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105.0), manufacturing output expansion signals strong corporate capacity utilization and rising profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO exceeds 105.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the annualized year-over-year growth rate of CPIAUCSL compresses real interest rates and increases inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with positive annualized CPIAUCSL growth, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0% for three consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0% for three consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 100,000 jobs per month signals robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS growth exceeds 100,000 jobs per month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions characterized by high retail sales (RSAFS > 750,000 million dollars), accelerating consumer demand drives positive corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where RSAFS exceeds 750,000 million dollars, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
